name: logistics-demand-forecast
description: Run API + Next.js from repo root

scripts.dev: npm run setup && (test -d web/node_modules || npm --prefix web install) && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else exec python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.bootstrap:backend: cd backend && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
